coldOpen.line: In April 1999, while bombs were falling on Belgrade, one football team got on a bus and drove into the city to play.
coldOpen.reveal: AEK played Partizan on 7 April 1999. Both teams walked out under one banner: 'Stop the war'. At 1–1, thousands ran onto the pitch — to hug the players.
neverSay: a minute for the pitch invasion (sources say 60, 62, 68 and 69)
'they made peace' — they sent a message of peace

beats.line: Founded in 1924 in Athens by refugees from Constantinople. The name means Athletic Union of Constantinople.
A double-headed Byzantine eagle — one head looks back to where they came from, one looks ahead.
beats.note: the looking-back/looking-ahead reading is the owner's storytelling; say it as 'fans say'
